entries.note: DOI resolves to Kim 2016 Ann Hematol (PMID 27696202; epub 2016-10-03, print 2017). Quote is verbatim in the abstract; 79 biopsies, PD-L1 79.7% tumour cells. Opening untested at 2016 is correct.

Tao 2021 STTT (PMC8548511), NCT03228836, ORR primary endpoint; quote verbatim; results first posted 2020-12-17 (CT.gov API). Paper cites EBV-driven PD-L1 only as rationale, so pairing correct. Tislelizumab cohort 1 stop (IDMC, modest efficacy) missed no prespecified bar; same holds.

Bachy 2023 Blood Adv (PMC10440460); quote verbatim, continues 'no firm conclusions can be made'. The PD-L1/ORR analysis pools cohorts 1-3 (ENKTL, PTCL, CTCL), so not ENKTL-only either: untested/unsettled stands.

entries.rule: Evidence rule 6: each cell opens at model_first_use_year with status untested (proxy allowed).
entries.note: Label quote verbatim (761232 lbl, 13.1). Bundled multidiscipline reviews have only TOC text for nonclinical (one 'cynomolgus' hit, Table 7 title). Status untested/no_prediction is fine; the track's only entry should open at 2016, not 2024.
entries.adjudication_note: Evidence rule 6: both agree on untested (no_prediction); the track opens at model_first_use_year, so the entry year should be 2016, not the 2024 label date. untested_reason no_prediction already set.

entries.rule: Evidence rule 6: track opens untested at model_first_use_year; retrodiction flag per 'A model built or run after the clinic already knew the answer'.
entries.note: Xue 2019 OTT (PMC6433108, epub 2019-03-19); quote verbatim in abstract. Full text confirms EL4-GFP in C57BL/6, BioXCell RMP1-14. Untested opening at 2019 stands; retrodiction should be true (see index 5).

entries.rule: Retrodiction: a model run after the clinic already knew the answer is retro, never same.
entries.note: ORIENT-4 quote verbatim (abstract); results posted 2020-12-17. But Xue's own intro says anti-PD-1 clinical efficacy in NKTL was already 'extensively investigated' (pembrolizumab 2017), and ORIENT-4 enrolled Aug 2017-Feb 2018, before the mouse work.
entries.adjudication_note: RULE QUESTION: Does a non-member same-target drug's public patient result (pembrolizumab, Kwong 2017) make a later model a retrodiction for the member class, given "only those drugs score"? No member result was public before Xue 2019.

missing: NK/T-cell-line tumour-bearing mouse model treated with anti-PD-1 (Wang/others 2019, Onco Targets Ther, doi:10.2147/OTT.S187280, PMID 30962691): improved survival in vivo, published 2019 before ORIENT-4 results; a candidate efficacy track (product_in_model likely false; antibody identity not checked) that could pair with ORIENT-4 (2020) as same.
ENKTL cell lines with STAT3-driven PD-L1 expression (Song et al. 2018, Blood) as an in-vitro rationale model; not verified in this check, likely no member drug dosed.

PD-L1 genomic structural alterations as a responder selector in NKTCL (Lim et al., Leukemia 2020) were tested on pembrolizumab only, outside the member list; noted so the drafter can record why it does not score.

Sintilimab plus chidamide in r/r ENKTL (STTT 2024, doi:10.1038/s41392-024-01825-0) not reviewed by the draft; check for any biomarker-vs-response comparison on a member drug (combination therapy, may fall outside the class).
rule_questions: The same system (ENKTL biopsy PD-L1 IHC) appears under two model_ids, enktl-biopsy-pdl1-ihc (class) and enktl-biopsy-pdl1-selector (patient). The brief says one system keeps one slug, but prediction_level differs; should class-level and patient-level uses of one system share a track?

Is patient tumour tissue IHC (no drug applied) a 'model system' for the efficacy question, or only a rationale? The rules allow ex_vivo patient material but do not say whether undosed tissue qualifies.

When a model predicted only direction (susceptibility), does a sibling member's trial stopped early by an IDMC for 'modest efficacy' (tislelizumab ORR 31.8%, no prespecified bar) count as contra for that drug, given 'one drug's contra beats another's same'?
ORIENT-4 interim results appeared as conference abstracts (ASH 2019) before the 2020-12-17 registry posting; do Blood supplement abstracts count as tier 1 for dating?

ENKTL anti-PD-1: does patient efficacy of a non-member anti-PD-1 (pembrolizumab, Kwong 2017) known before a model was run make that model a retrodiction for the member class (camrelizumab/sintilimab/tislelizumab)? Checker proposed retro for the EL4/RMP1-14 track; the member trial (ORIENT-4) had also completed enrolment before the model was published.
